title: The Brain, Body, and Behaviour Dataset (1.0.0) - Experiment 1
description: Eye-tracking data from 27 participants who watched five educational videos in two sessions: an attentive condition, in which participants were tested afterward with multiple-choice questions, and a distracted condition, in which they silently counted backwards. The dataset includes gaze, pupil size, blinks, saccades and fixations, plus questionnaires with domain and memory questions. It is Experiment 1 of the Brain, Body, and Behavior Dataset (BBBD) and supports research on attention and learning from video.
methods_description: Participants watched five informative YouTube videos while gaze position and pupil size were tracked. In the attentive session (ses-01) they answered 11-12 factual multiple-choice questions after each video. In the distracted session (ses-02) they watched the same videos in the same order while silently counting backwards from a random prime number in steps of 7, with no questions afterward. Videos and questions were presented in random order.
